title: M. canettii as the recombinant edge
dek: Smooth colonies and a larger accessory genome. Wikipedia's outlier is a warning label for H37Rv-only pipelines.
story: M. canettii sits on Wikipedia as a smooth-colony, putative ancestral-like mycobacterium related to MTBC. The teaching value is not romance about origins. It is that this organism recombines and carries accessory sequence that H37Rv-centric DST pipelines were not built to swallow.
Human disease is real but uncommon, classically Horn of Africa associations in case series. A canettii assembly is not 'failed TB WGS' because it looks weird on a snapshot tree.
Do not file it as NTM just because the colony is smooth. Do not file it as L4 because the NAAT said MTBC.
deep: PE/PPE masking and accessory genes will look like contamination to a strict H37Rv mapper. Inspect the tree before discarding.
Catalogue translation (WHO mutation catalogue) assumes MTBC clonal structure. Recombination breaks that assumption locally.
M. canettii is the exception that teaches the clonal rule for the rest of MTBC.
The clinic MTBC plate already says 'do not force-fit'. This card is the named Wikipedia taxon for that sentence.

visual.caption: Why canettii breaks a clonal MTBC mental model: extra accessory genome and recombination on top of a shared core.

example.title: Smooth and 'contaminated'
example.setup: A Horn of Africa isolate maps poorly to H37Rv, tree-sits beside canettii references, Kraken says MTBC.

steps.title: Say the name
steps.body: M. canettii on the report protects the catalogue from being over-read.

example.takeaway: The recombinant edge is a named taxon, not a dirty FASTQ.

check.prompt: Smooth colonies plus an MTBC-like core genome should first raise:
choices: M. canettii as a named edge taxon, not automatic NTM
check.answer: M. canettii as a named edge taxon, not automatic NTM
check.why: Smooth is the Wikipedia clue; the tree is the proof.

whyWrong.Lineage 2 Beijing: Clonal Mtb, not the smooth outlier.

check.prompt: An H37Rv-only mutation caller drops 12% of reads as unmapped in a canettii-like genome. Best next move:
choices: Call the run failed and discard
Inspect phylogeny/species and avoid over-translating an H37Rv catalogue
Report all unmapped reads as novel resistance genes
Treat as BCG because mapping failed
check.answer: Inspect phylogeny/species and avoid over-translating an H37Rv catalogue
check.why: The pipeline, not the organism, is misspecified.

whyWrong.Treat as BCG because mapping failed: BCG is a bovis derivative with RD deletions, not this pattern.

whyWrong.Smooth colony annotation alone: A clue in the caption, not a software layer.
